digest.component_or_area: Jira outbound sync / transition replay fallback
propositions: Direct Jira transitions fail when the workflow forbids them (e.g. open->done when only open->in_progress->done is allowed), causing status sync failure and ticket drift.
Replay fallback reconstructs recorded intermediate hops from append-only STATUS events and attempts transitions via those intermediate states using only existing TicketTransport seam.
Replay resumes from the current Jira status by matching it in Jira-name space without inverting LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA, anchoring on the last occurrence if duplicates exist.
Replay aborts on any hop raising RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError and falls through to comment-fallback with drift.
The replay call site is added to _update_one_scalar_update with local_id threaded as a new parameter, and reconciler_repo_root self-resolves the tracker without adding repo_root/tracker parameters.
